newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian F-104 crashes in sea, pilot's fate unknown.
newsitem.headline: Italian F-104 crashes in sea, pilot's fate unknown.

text.p: An Italian airforce F-104 fighter plane crashed into the Mediterranean sea during a training flight on Tuesday and helicopters were trying to locate the pilot, the airforce said.
A spokesman said the crash happened 40 miles north of the island of Pantelleria, midway between Sicily and the North Africa coast, during an exercise with two other planes.
"The aircraft lost contact with the other planes. We have no information that the plane had any problems or any confirmation that the pilot ejected," the spokesman said.
